hooks.command: if ! git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; BASELINE_PR=0; UNCAPTURED=$(git log develop --format='%s' 2>/dev/null | awk -v base="$BASELINE_PR" '/^chore\(lessons\): capture/ { rest = $0; while (match(rest, /PR#[0-9]+/)) { captured[substr(rest, RSTART+3, RLENGTH-3)] = 1; rest = substr(rest, RSTART+RLENGTH) } next } /\(#[0-9]+\)$/ { match($0, /\(#[0-9]+\)$/); n = substr($0, RSTART+2, RLENGTH-3); if (n > base && !(n in captured) && !(n in seen)) { seen[n] = 1; print n } }' | head -1); if [ -n "$UNCAPTURED" ]; then printf '\033[33m⚠️  Merge detected without lesson capture: PR#%s. Run /capture-lessons %s to extract lessons.\033[0m\n' "$UNCAPTURED" "$UNCAPTURED" >&2; fi; exit 0
